sentences.cn_text: 协议就是协议——但显然，当涉及 Entergy 公司时则另当别论。
sentences.en_text: A deal is a deal — except, apparently, when Entergy is involved.

sentences.cn_text: 该公司是新英格兰地区的主要能源供应商，上周在佛蒙特州宣布将违背长期以来遵守该州严格核能法规的承诺，引发了正当的愤怒。
sentences.en_text: The company, a major energy supplier in New England, provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week when it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the state’s strict nuclear regulations.

sentences.cn_text: 相反，该公司恰恰做了它长期以来承诺不会做的事情：在联邦法院质疑佛蒙特州法规的合宪性，这是其力图维持佛蒙特洋基核电站运营的孤注一掷之举的一部分。
sentences.en_text: Instead, the company has done precisely what it had long promised it would not: challenge the constitutionality of Vermont’s rules in the federal court, as part of a desperate effort to keep its Vermont Yankee nuclear power plant running.

sentences.cn_text: 这是一个令人震惊的举动。
sentences.en_text: It’s a stunning move.

sentences.cn_text: 自2002年该公司收购佛蒙特州唯一的核电站——一座位于弗农的老化反应堆以来，这一冲突就开始显现。
sentences.en_text: The conflict has been surfacing since 2002, when the corporation bought Vermont’s only nuclear power plant, an aging reactor in Vernon.

sentences.cn_text: 作为获得州政府批准该交易的条件，该公司同意向州监管机构申请许可以在2012年后继续运营。
sentences.en_text: As a condition of receiving state approval for the sale, the company agreed to seek permission from state regulators to operate past 2012.

sentences.cn_text: 2006年，州政府进一步要求，该电站许可证的任何延期都须经佛蒙特州立法机构批准。
sentences.en_text: In 2006, the state went a step further, requiring that any extension of the plant’s license be subject to Vermont legislature’s approval.

sentences.cn_text: 当时，该公司也表示同意。
sentences.en_text: Then, too, the company went along.

sentences.cn_text: 要么 Entergy 从未真正打算履行这些承诺,要么它根本没有预见到接下来会发生什么。
sentences.en_text: Either Entergy never really intended to live by those commitments, or it simply didn’t foresee what would happen next.

sentences.cn_text: 一系列事故，包括2007年冷却塔部分坍塌和地下管道系统泄漏的发现，引发了对佛蒙特洋基核电站安全性及 Entergy 管理能力的严重质疑——尤其是在该公司就管道问题发表误导性声明之后。
sentences.en_text: A string of accidents, including the partial collapse of a cooling tower in 2007 and the discovery of an underground pipe system leakage, raised serious questions about both Vermont Yankee’s safety and Entergy’s management — especially after the company made misleading statements about the pipe.

sentences.cn_text: 由于对 Entergy 行为的愤怒，佛蒙特州参议院去年以26票对4票的结果否决了延期申请。
sentences.en_text: Enraged by Entergy’s behavior, the Vermont Senate voted 26 to 4 last year against allowing an extension.

sentences.cn_text: 现在该公司突然声称，由于2006年的立法，2002年的协议已失效，并且只有联邦政府对核问题拥有监管权。
sentences.en_text: Now the company is suddenly claiming that the 2002 agreement is invalid because of the 2006 legislation, and that only the federal government has regulatory power over nuclear issues.

sentences.cn_text: 该案的法律问题尚不明朗：尽管最高法院裁定各州确实对核能拥有一定的监管权，但法律学者表示，佛蒙特州案件将成为检验这些权力延伸范围的一次具有先例意义的考验。
sentences.en_text: The legal issues in the case are obscure: whereas the Supreme Court has ruled that states do have some regulatory authority over nuclear power, legal scholars say the Vermont case will offer a precedent-setting test of how far those powers extend.

sentences.cn_text: 当然，如果每个州都制定自己的规则，由此可能导致的拼凑式法规确实令人担忧。
sentences.en_text: Certainly, there are valid concerns about the patchwork regulations that could result if every state sets its own rules.

sentences.cn_text: 但如果 Entergy 信守承诺，这场争论就不会存在。
sentences.en_text: But had Entergy kept its word, that debate would be beside the point.

sentences.cn_text: 该公司似乎认定其在佛蒙特州的声誉已经损毁殆尽，因此与该州对抗也不会有更多损失。
sentences.en_text: The company seems to have concluded that its reputation in Vermont is already so damaged that it has nothing left to lose by going to war with the state.

sentences.cn_text: 但应该会有后果。
sentences.en_text: But there should be consequences.

sentences.cn_text: 运营核电站的许可是一种公共信托。
sentences.en_text: Permission to run a nuclear plant is a public trust.

sentences.cn_text: Entergy 在美国运营着其他11座反应堆，包括位于普利茅斯的朝圣者核电站。
sentences.en_text: Entergy runs 11 other reactors in the United States, including Pilgrim Nuclear station in Plymouth.

sentences.cn_text: 该公司承诺安全运营朝圣者核电站，并已向联邦申请许可使其再运营20年。
sentences.en_text: Pledging to run Pilgrim safely, the company has applied for federal permission to keep it open for another 20 years.

sentences.cn_text: 但当核管理委员会（NRC）审查该公司的申请时，应当牢记 Entergy 的承诺究竟有多少价值。
sentences.en_text: But as the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reviews the company’s application, it should keep in mind what promises from Entergy are worth.

sentences.cn_text: 短语「reneging on」（第一段）的意思最接近____。
sentences.en_text: The phrase “reneging on” (Para. 1) is closest in meaning to ____

sentences.cn_text: 谴责。
sentences.en_text: condemning.

sentences.cn_text: 重申。
sentences.en_text: reaffirming.

sentences.cn_text: 违背。
sentences.en_text: dishonoring.

sentences.cn_text: 获得。
sentences.en_text: securing.

sentences.cn_text: 通过签署2002年的协议，Entergy 的意图是____。
sentences.en_text: By entering into the 2002 agreement, Entergy intended to ____

sentences.cn_text: 获得佛蒙特州监管机构的保护。
sentences.en_text: obtain protection from Vermont regulators.

sentences.cn_text: 寻求联邦立法机构的支持。
sentences.en_text: seek favor from the federal legislature.

sentences.cn_text: 获得其营业执照的延期。
sentences.en_text: acquire an extension of its business license.

sentences.cn_text: 获得购买发电厂的许可。
sentences.en_text: get permission to purchase a power plant.

sentences.cn_text: 根据第四段，Entergy 似乎在____方面存在问题。
sentences.en_text: According to Paragraph 4, Entergy seems to have problems with its ____

sentences.cn_text: 管理做法。
sentences.en_text: managerial practices.

sentences.cn_text: 技术创新。
sentences.en_text: technical innovativeness.

sentences.cn_text: 财务目标。
sentences.en_text: financial goals.

sentences.cn_text: 商业远见。
sentences.en_text: business vision.

sentences.cn_text: 在作者看来，佛蒙特州案件将检验____。
sentences.en_text: In the author’s view, the Vermont case will test ____

sentences.cn_text: Entergy 履行其所有承诺的能力。
sentences.en_text: Entergy’s capacity to fulfill all its promises.

sentences.cn_text: 各州拼凑式法规的性质。
sentences.en_text: the nature of states’ patchwork regulations.

sentences.cn_text: 联邦政府对核问题的权威。
sentences.en_text: the federal authority over nuclear issues.

sentences.cn_text: 州对核问题权力的边界。
sentences.en_text: the limits of states’ power over nuclear issues.

sentences.cn_text: 从最后一段可以推断出____。
sentences.en_text: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that ____

sentences.cn_text: Entergy 在其他地方的业务可能会受到影响。
sentences.en_text: Entergy’s business elsewhere might be affected.

sentences.cn_text: NRC 的权威将受到蔑视。
sentences.en_text: the authority of the NRC will be defied.

sentences.cn_text: Entergy 将撤回其普利茅斯申请。
sentences.en_text: Entergy will withdraw its Plymouth application.

sentences.cn_text: 佛蒙特州的声誉可能会受损。
sentences.en_text: Vermont’s reputation might be damaged.
